Yes, in a park listed in Schedule A you may possess an open container of liquor and consume liquor between 5:30 a.m. and 12 a.m. without a permit, provided you are not within a pool or deck boundary or within two metres of a playground, wading pool or splash pad, skateboard or BMX park, or ice rink [1][2].
Note that the City's documents here don't state whether the Schedule A exception applies on a particular park's own terms beyond these rules.
The documents don't cover whether a park-access rule about non-recreational use or entry changes this [3].

A Tuesday is not a Saturday or pre-holiday day, so the midnight extension does not apply to the old wording, and the City documents provided do not state any current closing-hour rule for second-hand goods dealers after 2026-09-30.
The rules that now apply to licensed second-hand goods dealers do not set a closing hour for a Tuesday, and the documents don't state any other closing-hour rule for that business.
